attachmentSets.name: Ultimate Pursuit
attachmentSets.description: Increases the damage, healing, and shield effects of Ultimate skills by 5%. Gains 1 stack after each use of an Ultimate skill, up to a maximum of 4 stacks.

attachmentSets.name: Double Strategy
attachmentSets.description: When enemy target is not near Cover, increases targeted damage by 10%. When enemy target is near Cover, increases AoE damage by 10%.

attachmentSets.name: Phase Strike
attachmentSets.description: Deals 15% increased damage to targets with Phase Element debuffs.

attachmentSets.name: Phase Resonance
attachmentSets.description: If the active skill exploits a phase weakness, gains Phase Boost I for 1 turn before the attack. If it exploits two phase weaknesses, increases damage dealt by 10%.

attachmentSets.name: Emergency Repair
attachmentSets.description: If the allied unit's HP is fully healed by an active skill, restores 2 points of their stability index. Triggers up to once per turn.

attachmentSets.name: Ally Support
attachmentSets.description: When using defense skills, additionally applied Area Defense II to allied units for 2 turns.

attachmentSets.name: Ballistic Boost
attachmentSets.description: When dealing Physical damage, the damage is increased by 20%.

attachmentSets.name: Burn Boost
attachmentSets.description: When dealing Burn damage, the damage is increased by 20%.

attachmentSets.name: Freeze Boost
attachmentSets.description: When dealing Freeze damage, the damage is increased by 20%.

attachmentSets.name: Corrosion Boost
attachmentSets.description: When dealing Corrosion damage, the damage is increased by 20%.

attachmentSets.name: Electric Boost
attachmentSets.description: When dealing Electric damage, the damage is increased by 20%.

attachmentSets.name: Hydro Boost
attachmentSets.description: When dealing Hydro damage, the damage is increased by 20%.
